guesses.breed: American Pit Bull Terrier / American Staffordshire Terrier
guesses.reason: Broad blocky skull, short smooth blue-gray coat, folded rose-style ears, and a strong muscular muzzle are classic pit bull-type traits.
The solid gray-blue coloring, slightly loose lips, and a larger, heavier head hint at some mastiff-type influence.
The softer, slightly longer muzzle and gentle expression could reflect some retriever ancestry.

breed.appearance: Jerry has a short, sleek, solid blue-gray (slate) coat with a faint lighter dusting of gray on the forehead and muzzle, a broad flat-topped head, and a dark gray-black nose. His ears are small-to-medium and folded back in a rose shape, and his round, dark brown eyes give a soft, soulful, slightly droopy expression. He is a sturdy, medium-large dog shown snuggled in a cream fluffy blanket while wearing a blue harness with gray reflective stripes.
breed.fun_fact: Pit bull-type dogs are famously affectionate couch-cuddlers who love nothing more than being close to their people!
